type: Retrospective spontaneous-report case-noncase disproportionality sensitivity analysis; not a longitudinal patient cohort.
sources: Same 29 FAERS releases 2019Q1 through 2026Q1 and latest-report index; stage8 audited PT/exposure cache is explicitly reused.
unit: Unique latest PRIMARYID/CASEID report, not a unique patient.
sglt2_definition: Regulator-documented SGLT2-active ingredients, including dual SGLT1/2 sotagliflozin, with salts and combination products. A union of drugname and PROD_AI matches; unknown or unmatched is not evidence of no use. Unmapped GLIFLOZIN-containing terms are audited before estimates.
exclusions: Any PS/SS record matching the locked SGLT2-active dictionary
Any recorded role matching the same dictionary
contrasts: Two mTOR target drugs x two exclusion rules = 4 planned contrasts. Preserve existing target PS exposure definition. Symmetrically exclude reports from all four cells. All five original drugs receive descriptive co-report counts only.
formulation_addendum: Two separately labelled exploratory FAERS contrasts for explicitly named FYARRO/nab-sirolimus/protein-bound-sirolimus records: PS and PS/SS roles. Generic sirolimus alone never establishes formulation. Keep original five-drug primary family unchanged; show both planned addendum rows even if not estimable.
multiplicity: A new BY family contains all estimable tests among the 6 planned additional contrasts; nominal exact 95% CIs and Fisher P also reported. Do not merge into or selectively alter previous families.
background_change: Give deleted and remaining a/b/c/d, proportion of background outcome reports excluded, ROR after/before if defined. ROR ratio is descriptive; no causal masking percentage and no independent-estimates test.
missingness: Audit PRIMARYID, DRUG_SEQ, drugname, PROD_AI, role, and report-level combinations. Retain unknown-role matches in any-role restriction only. No imputation. Do not infer baseline diabetes or temporal co-use.
stop_rules: Stop on report-index mismatch, exposure/PT baseline mismatch, malformed source records affecting classification, unmatched unresolved candidate identities, or a material drugname/ingredient conflict. Never expand exclusions until a desired signal appears.
status: Implemented exploratory background-comparison rules; not an original prospective selection protocol.
